name: xyz.gobob/gateway
title: BOB Gateway
description: Swap native BTC to and from tokens on EVM chains and Tron through BOB Gateway

tools.name: create_order
tools.description:
Create an order from a quote. Returns the order id plus what the user must sign: a
deposit address / PSBT for onramps, or the EVM or Tron transaction otherwise.

quote.description: The quote object exactly as returned by `get_quote`, e.g. {"onramp": {...}}; not a string

tools.name: get_max_spendable
tools.description: Maximum BTC (sats) an address can send to an onramp after estimated network fees.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order's status and details.

id.description: Order id, source Bitcoin txid, or source EVM tx hash

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: List orders for one or more user addresses, paginated.

user_addresses.description: User addresses (up to 20), each encoded for its own chain

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description:
Get a quote for a swap (onramp quotes are signed by the API). Pass the returned object
unchanged to `create_order`.

affiliates.description:
Affiliate fees as comma-separated `<address>:<bps>` pairs, e.g. "0xabc...:50". Addresses
are EVM, except on a token swap to Tron, where a Tron address is also accepted.

amount.description: Amount to swap as an integer string in the source token's smallest unit

recipient.description: Address receiving the funds, encoded for the destination chain

refund_address.description: Refund address on the source chain. Optional here, required by create-order.

sender.description:
Address sending the funds, encoded for the source chain. On onramps it lets create-order
return a funded PSBT, which may spend the address's ordinals, inscriptions or runes as
plain sats: omit it for an address holding any.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (max 1000). Omit to let the gateway pick one per route.

tools.name: get_routes
tools.description: List supported swap routes (source/destination chain and token pairs).

dst_chain.description: Only routes to this chain, e.g. "ethereum"

src_chain.description: Only routes from this chain, e.g. "bitcoin"

tools.name: quote_and_create
tools.description:
Get a quote and create an order from it in one call, returning both as `quote` and
`order`. Takes the `get_quote` arguments, with `refund_address` required. Creating an
order screens its addresses, so use this only once the user wants to swap, and `get_quote`
to check a price.

affiliates.description:
Affiliate fees as comma-separated `<address>:<bps>` pairs, e.g. "0xabc...:50". Addresses
are EVM, except on a token swap to Tron, where a Tron address is also accepted.

amount.description: Amount to swap as an integer string in the source token's smallest unit

recipient.description: Address receiving the funds, encoded for the destination chain

refund_address.description: Refund address on the source chain

sender.description:
Address sending the funds, encoded for the source chain. On onramps it lets create-order
return a funded PSBT, which may spend the address's ordinals, inscriptions or runes as
plain sats: omit it for an address holding any.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (max 1000). Omit to let the gateway pick one per route.

tools.name: register_tx
tools.description:
Broadcast an already-signed onramp Bitcoin transaction through the gateway. Optional:
deposits are detected on-chain without it. The broadcast cannot be undone.

bitcoin_tx_hex.description: Hex-encoded, fully signed Bitcoin transaction paying the order's deposit address

tools.name: wait_for_order
tools.description:
Wait for an order's status to leave `inProgress`, reading it every 15 seconds for up to
about 45. Returns the order as `get_order` does, as soon as its status changes or once
the wait is over; call again while it is still `inProgress`. Under heavy load it may
return after a single read. Reports progress when the client asks for it.

id.description: Order id, source Bitcoin txid, or source EVM tx hash
